doc: Resets a D_80086C00[] sound-driver slot (index a0) to its free/default state: sets D_80085F98 mode flag, calls func_80059D1C() and func_80056A08(), then clears the slot's field_0/field_2/field_8/field_A fields (field_0=-1 marks it free), and finally clears the D_80085F98 flag.
